LanguageData.Strata_SmokeInhalation.label: 吸入烟雾
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeInhalation.description: 在不通风房间吸入的废气。到新鲜空气中会消退，但在浓烟中久留会窒息肺部——大量时致命。
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeInhalation.stages_0.label: 轻微
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeInhalation.stages_1.label: 咳嗽
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeInhalation.stages_2.label: 窒息
LanguageData.Strata_GasInhalation.label: 吸入深层气体
LanguageData.Strata_GasInhalation.description: 在充满恶臭地下气体的房间中吸入。到新鲜空气中会消退，但在浓气中久留会毒害血液并麻痹心智——大量时致命。
LanguageData.Strata_GasInhalation.stages_0.label: 眩晕
LanguageData.Strata_GasInhalation.stages_1.label: 中毒
LanguageData.Strata_GasInhalation.stages_2.label: 窒息
LanguageData.Strata_Hypoxia.label: 缺氧
LanguageData.Strata_Hypoxia.description: 空气中氧气不足。新鲜空气进入房间后会消退，但在密封深层楼层久留会缓慢窒息肺部。
LanguageData.Strata_Hypoxia.stages_0.label: 气短
LanguageData.Strata_Hypoxia.stages_1.label: 喘息
LanguageData.Strata_Hypoxia.stages_2.label: 窒息
LanguageData.Strata_CO2Exposure.label: 二氧化碳暴露
LanguageData.Strata_CO2Exposure.description: 空气中二氧化碳过多。通风后会消退，但积在密封房间的重气体会引发头痛、混乱并最终失去意识。
LanguageData.Strata_CO2Exposure.stages_0.label: 头痛
LanguageData.Strata_CO2Exposure.stages_1.label: 困倦
LanguageData.Strata_CO2Exposure.stages_2.label: 昏迷
LanguageData.Strata_MethaneExposure.label: 甲烷暴露
LanguageData.Strata_MethaneExposure.description: 吸入浓重矿井气。轻微眩晕——真正危险在于点火而非中毒。
LanguageData.Strata_MethaneExposure.stages_0.label: 轻微眩晕
LanguageData.Strata_MethaneExposure.stages_1.label: 眩晕
LanguageData.Strata_BlackDampExposure.label: 黑潮暴露
LanguageData.Strata_BlackDampExposure.description: 缺氧滞留空气。到新鲜空气中或用洗涤器可消退，但在黑潮坑中久留会悄然窒息。
LanguageData.Strata_BlackDampExposure.stages_0.label: 窒息感
LanguageData.Strata_BlackDampExposure.stages_1.label: 喘息
LanguageData.Strata_BlackDampExposure.stages_2.label: 窒息
LanguageData.Strata_SporeSickness.label: 孢子病
LanguageData.Strata_SporeSickness.description: 肺部真菌孢子。过滤器与洗涤器可净化空气；不治疗时暴露会导致发热虚弱与坏心情。
LanguageData.Strata_SporeSickness.stages_0.label: 肺痒
LanguageData.Strata_SporeSickness.stages_1.label: 发热
LanguageData.Strata_SporeSickness.stages_2.label: 虚脱
LanguageData.Strata_SteamScald.label: 蒸汽烫伤
LanguageData.Strata_SteamScald.description: 灼热地热蒸汽烫伤皮肤与呼吸道。到更凉爽通风的空气中会消退。
LanguageData.Strata_SteamScald.stages_0.label: 灼热
LanguageData.Strata_SteamScald.stages_1.label: 烫伤
LanguageData.Strata_SteamScald.stages_2.label: 严重烫伤
